goal: Unify exact finite ecological-world falsification, observation-process uncertainty, projection, and next-evidence design in one domain-agnostic API.

model.ecological_world: finite mapping target_id -> latent ecological state label
model.observation_world: finite mapping channel_id × ecological_state -> finite possible outcome set
model.compatibility: joint world survives iff every observed outcome belongs to its declared support set
model.ecological_projection: unique ecological worlds represented among surviving joint worlds
model.observation_projection: unique observation worlds represented among surviving joint worlds

planner.action: finite support set of possible outcomes for every currently surviving joint world
planner.fail_closed: If no candidate action strictly improves the chosen worst-case objective, best_action is null.

hypotheses.claim: A generic v3 adapter exactly reproduces the frozen v2.7 strict/broad/calibrated ecological projections and survivor counts.
hypotheses.rule: Any count or world-set mismatch refutes V3_1.

hypotheses.claim: The v3 planner exactly reproduces v2.8 action metrics and objective-specific winners.
hypotheses.rule: Any action metric or winner mismatch refutes V3_2.

hypotheses.claim: Appending evidence to a fixed joint universe cannot increase the surviving joint set or either projection.
hypotheses.rule: Any expansion after an evidence update refutes V3_3.

hypotheses.claim: Holding ecological worlds and evidence fixed, expanding the declared observation-world universe cannot remove an ecological survivor and may add survivors.
hypotheses.rule: Any survivor loss after universe expansion refutes V3_4.

hypotheses.claim: If every candidate action has the same worst-case value as the current state for the chosen objective, v3 returns no preferred action.

boundaries: No claim that the finite ecological universe contains truth.
No hard falsification from nonzero-probability histories.
Action ranking is objective-specific and robust-support based.
v3 is an API consolidation; parent scientific results are not reinterpreted.
